name: Hope Apartments
_base: Where the site is served from. "/hope-vodice" puts every page and asset under that path and builds into a folder of the same name, which is how it is deployed to Vercel for review. Set it to "" when the site moves to the real domain root, then rebuild and move assets/ back up a level.
description: Three apartments in one family house in the centre of Vodice, Croatia. 600 m from Mala Vrulje beach, 300 m from ACI Marina. Air conditioning, full kitchen, free Wi-Fi and a kamado grill. Book direct with your hosts.
tagline: Three apartments in one house, right in Vodice.

distances.detail: 600 m, about eight minutes on foot

items.q: What is the difference between the three apartments?
items.a: H1 and H2 are both 40 m² for up to four guests, on the first floor. H1 has a child bed and the kamado grill; H2 has a kitchen with a full stove. H3 is the big one: 70 m² on the top floor, two separate bedrooms for up to six guests, and a 33 m² private balcony.

items.q: Can we book more than one apartment?
items.a: Yes, and families often do. The three are in the same house, so a larger group can take two apartments and still eat together. Tell us the dates and how many of you there are and we will work out which combination fits.

Air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, a full kitchen with a fridge and coffee machine, a private bathroom with a shower, hairdryer and free toiletries, a flat-screen TV, an in-room safe and a balcony. The kamado charcoal grill is shared.
Ask us when you book and we will tell you exactly where to leave the car. The house is in the middle of Vodice, so most guests park once and walk everywhere.

items.q: Is booking direct cheaper than Booking.com?
items.a: Yes. Booking direct skips the platform commission, so the rate you see here is the lowest we offer, and you deal with Nada and Bernard rather than a messaging system.

items.q: How do I confirm a reservation?
items.a: Send us your dates. We reply with the total and payment details for the deposit that holds the booking. Nothing is confirmed until we have written back to you, so always wait for our reply.

items.q: What if I need to cancel?
items.a: Cancel more than 30 days before arrival and the deposit comes back to you in full. Plans change and we would far rather hear about it early.

items.q: What time can we check in and out?
items.a: Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 10:00. We live in Vodice ourselves, so if you arrive early or leave late, tell us and we will do what the cleaning schedule allows.

items.q: How do we get to Vodice?
items.a: Split airport is 70 km away and Zadar airport 76 km, both roughly an hour by car. There is no train to Vodice; the nearest station is Šibenik, 12 km away, with regular buses.
